scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @playball/rules && npm run build --workspace @playball/engine && npm run build --workspace @playball/api && npm run build --workspace @playball/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @playball/rules && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @playball/rules && tsx --test packages/rules/test/*.test.ts packages/engine/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:engine && npm run verify:design
